chapter.v:
The Lord
reigns, clothed in majesty! He wears his royal robes, with his power worn like a belt. The world is held together firmly—it cannot be broken apart.

Your throne
has existed from ages past; you are from eternity.

The floods
have raised up, Lord; the floods have raised their voices; the floods have raised up their crashing waves.

But greater
than the most violent ocean, greater than the largest waves of the sea, the greatest is the Lord above.

Your laws
are totally trustworthy. Your house, Lord, is holy forever.
